# Test fixtures

- `songgraphs/*.json` — generated by `scripts/gen-fixtures.ts` (synthetic
  chord/note arrays, no recordings). Regenerate with
  `pnpm exec tsx scripts/gen-fixtures.ts`.
- `simple-song.mp3` — a few seconds of synthesized audio (ffmpeg tone sweep),
  generated locally during development; no copyrighted recording. Used only by
  `tests/integration/ingest.test.ts` to exercise the ingest pipeline.
